scope: Replacement Android release 1.0.1 (2), not the historical uploaded 1.0.0 (1).
device: Disposable AlienPetTablet Android 36 Google APIs emulator, serial emulator-5580. Root ADB allows inspection of release-package private files. No physical device or personal save is touched.
artifact: Signed universal APK generated from the final AAB; verify package, version, signing fingerprint, no debuggable/testOnly, manifest and ZIP alignment before installation.
observations: UI screenshot and action history for equal age choices and separate adult analytics choice.
Synthetic local PlayerPrefs privacy state across force-stop/relaunch.
Package-private file names indicating Firebase Installations, Remote Config, Analytics, UMP or Ads. Never print identifier contents.
Release-process logcat SDK initialization/error markers, including absence/presence of AdMob-ready messages.
Root BPF mAppUidStatsMap cumulative rx/tx bytes before and after each case; compare deltas, not counters across unrelated cases.
AppOps and merged-manifest permissions/defaults. A permission check alone is not a network/privacy proof.

cases.name: unknown
cases.action: Launch and leave age selection unanswered for at least 60 seconds.
cases.expect: No UMP/AdMob/Firebase initialization evidence, no Firebase/FID/RC data files, no app-UID network delta; no intro/play before confirmation.

cases.name: under13
cases.action: Select Under 13, confirm, skip intro, play; force-stop and relaunch.
cases.expect: Gameplay works, choice persists, no optional Analytics prompt, no ad offers and no SDK/FID/RC artifacts or app-UID network delta.

cases.name: teen13to15
cases.action: Select 13–15, confirm; wait for UMP outcome, play and relaunch.
cases.expect: No optional Analytics prompt/game Analytics/RC/FID fetch. Restricted UMP/Ads can process operational data; contextual ad settings checked in source tests. UMP configuration errors fail closed; no ad initialization after a failed consent update.

cases.name: teen16to17
cases.expect: Same conservative policy as 13–15; coarse age-treatment flags may be sent to Google, not a promise of zero network for teens.

cases.name: adult_decline
cases.action: Select 18 or older, leave the Analytics prompt unanswered, then Not now; play and relaunch.
cases.expect: Before choice, no SDK. Decline persists and gameplay continues; no game Analytics or RC. UMP/Ads may operate once eligible after successful consent handling.

cases.name: adult_allow_withdraw
cases.action: Select 18 or older, Allow analytics; play; open Privacy and turn Analytics off; play again and relaunch.
cases.expect: Only opt-in initializes game Firebase/RC, consent grants AnalyticsStorage only and denies advertising consent. Withdrawal persists and stops further app event/RC processing. Existing/in-flight server work is not retroactively deleted or cancellable.

layout_checks: Capture age/analytics/Privacy panels in tablet portrait, tablet landscape and a phone-sized emulator display; confirm accessible equal choices and no clipped controls.
limitations: SDK log silence and absence of private files alone cannot prove absence of all network processing. Combine evidence and state the observation window.
UID accounting cannot attribute traffic delegated to Google Play services to this app; packet/domain or SDK inspection may be needed if unexplained evidence appears.
Advertising-ID permission removal blocks ordinary AAID access on Android 13+, not a guarantee for older supported Android versions. Ads can use app-set/other IDs.
Native release behavior is distinct from Editor tests. Ad serving success may be blocked by AdMob app review or UMP publisher configuration; this must be reported rather than bypassed.
Emulator synthetic tests do not certify every jurisdiction, age misrepresentation scenario, SDK version, actual production ad response, device or OS.
